en: Illustrated color postcard showing a Baroque church façade and surrounding buildings in an urban square. The church has ornate sculptural decoration, a central portal, and a small tower with a bulbous dome. Multi‑story townhouses with red roofs and shuttered windows flank the church. Trees and a few small human figures appear in the foreground. Handwritten cursive text runs vertically along the right side. Printed captions in German are at the top and bottom edges.
